simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גָּלַשׁ (H1570) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גָּלַשׁ (gâlash) means probably to caper (as a goat) First listed occurrence: Song 4 1.

definitions.full: H1570. galash [ גָּלַשׁ ] verb sit, sit up , possibly also recline (compare Arabic sit up ; so Thes De and others (not Ew)) — only Qal Perfect (שֶׁ)גָָּֽלִשׁוּ Song 4:1 ; 6:5 גִּלְעָד מ(הר) שֶׁגָּלְשׁוּ of flocks of goats, in simile of a woman's hair; construction & sense rather awkward. גַּם see below גמם .
